===== .cache/memory-views/paired.py SHA256 5b00004a4e8579d84f61d3d515f29e40208d551c049a1e787a76141bccf56b44 =====
"""Run only frozen leaves, preserving every raw result and partial failure."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import collections
import datetime
import json
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

from freeze import ROOT, ENV_KEYS, path, roles, verify


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def parse_row(output, leaf, plan):
    rows = [line for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith("Benchmark")]
    assert len(rows) == 1, (leaf, rows, output)
    fields = rows[0].split()
    expected_name = "/".join(leaf["parts"]) + "-" + str(plan["framework_procs"])
    assert fields[0] == expected_name, (expected_name, rows[0])
    assert len(fields) >= 8 and len(fields) % 2 == 0, rows[0]
    assert int(fields[1]) > 0, rows[0]
    metrics = {}
    for offset in range(2, len(fields), 2):
        unit = fields[offset + 1]
        assert unit not in metrics, rows[0]
        metrics[unit] = float(fields[offset])
        assert math.isfinite(metrics[unit]), rows[0]
    assert set(metrics) >= {"ns/op", "B/op", "allocs/op"}, rows[0]
    if leaf["metric_required"]:
        assert metrics.get("actual-procs") == leaf["actual_procs"], rows[0]
    elif "actual-procs" in metrics:
        assert metrics["actual-procs"] == leaf["actual_procs"], rows[0]
    assert "goos: linux" in output and "goarch: amd64" in output, output
    assert "\nPASS\n" in "\n" + output, output
    return {"name": fields[0], "iterations": int(fields[1]), "metrics": metrics, "raw_row": rows[0]}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("snapshot", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True, help="new directory, never append to old rounds")
    parser.add_argument("--execute-isolated", action="store_true", help="explicit acknowledgement that all build/test/reviewer tools are stopped")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.execute_isolated:
        parser.error("no timings without --execute-isolated; external process isolation must already be established")
    snapshot_file = args.snapshot.resolve()
    snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_file.read_text())
    verify(snapshot)
    plan = snapshot["plan"]
    config = snapshot["config"]
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (args.output / "frozen.json").write_text(snapshot_file.read_text())
    env = dict(os.environ, GOTOOLCHAIN="local", CGO_ENABLED="0", GOAMD64="v1", GOMAXPROCS=str(plan["framework_procs"]))
    conditions = {"started_utc": now(), "affinity": sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
                  "environment": {key: env.get(key, "default") for key in ENV_KEYS},
                  "snapshot": str(snapshot_file), "command": sys.argv,
                  "isolation": "Operator acknowledged isolation; this driver cannot establish absence of external work."}
    assert conditions["affinity"] == snapshot["affinity"], "affinity changed since freeze"
    (args.output / "run-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(conditions, indent=2) + "\n")
    counts = collections.Counter()
    with (args.output / "records.jsonl").open("x") as records:
        for round_info in plan["rounds"]:
            round_name = round_info["name"]
            leaves = plan["leaves"][::-1] if round_info["reverse"] else plan["leaves"]
            for sample in range(1, plan["samples"] + 1):
                for index, leaf in enumerate(leaves):
                    selected = list(roles(plan, leaf))
                    if sample % 2 == 0:
                        selected.reverse()
                    if round_info["reverse"]:
                        selected.reverse()
                    query = "/".join("^" + re.escape(part) + "$" for part in leaf["parts"])
                    for role in selected:
                        command = [str(path(config["binaries"][role])), "-test.run=^$", "-test.bench=" + query,
                                   "-test.benchtime=" + round_info["duration"], "-test.count=1", "-test.benchmem",
                                   "-test.cpu=" + str(plan["framework_procs"])]
                        filename = args.output / f"{round_name}-{sample:02}-{index:02}-{role}.txt"
                        started = now()
                        with filename.open("x") as raw:
                            raw.write("START " + started + "\nCOMMAND " + json.dumps(command) + "\n")
                            raw.flush()
                            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=raw, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
                            raw.write("\nEND " + now() + "\nEXIT " + str(result.returncode) + "\n")
                        if result.returncode:
                            raise RuntimeError(f"benchmark failed; complete raw failure retained at {filename}")
                        text = filename.read_text()
                        parsed = parse_row(text, leaf, plan)
                        record = {"round": round_name, "sample": sample, "role": role, "family": leaf["family"],
                                  "parts": leaf["parts"], "raw": filename.name, "started_utc": started, **parsed}
                        records.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
                        records.flush()
                        counts[(round_name, role, parsed["name"])] += 1
                print("PASS", round_name, sample, flush=True)
            verify(snapshot)
            for leaf in plan["leaves"]:
                name = "/".join(leaf["parts"]) + "-" + str(plan["framework_procs"])
                for role in roles(plan, leaf):
                    assert counts[(round_name, role, name)] == plan["samples"], (round_name, role, name, counts)
            print("COMPLETE", round_name, flush=True)
    expected = len(plan["rounds"]) * plan["samples"] * sum(len(roles(plan, leaf)) for leaf in plan["leaves"])
    assert sum(counts.values()) == expected
    verify(snapshot)
    (args.output / "complete.json").write_text(json.dumps({"completed_utc": now(), "rows": expected}, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("PASS", expected, "raw rows retained; frozen hashes unchanged", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== .cache/memory-views/prepare-reload.py SHA256 37c96df04ec8536b42c7e3abd6da583efbddf9ce4d03ed7a845e410d39c9ce74 =====
"""SHA-pinned diagnostic control from final production output, never a pass."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--sha256", required=True, help="independently recorded final production module digest")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--provenance", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--overlay", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--production-path", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    raw = args.source.read_bytes()
    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    assert actual == args.sha256, (actual, args.sha256)
    lines = raw.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    capture = re.compile(r"^(\s*)(cocoonMemoryView[1-9][0-9]*) = ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*)\.memory\s*$")
    access = re.compile(r"\b(load32|store32)\((cocoonMemoryView[1-9][0-9]*),")
    function_start = re.compile(r"^func \([^\n]*\) ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*)\(")
    function = None
    views = {}
    regions = []
    accesses = []
    counts = {}
    extra = []
    output = []
    original_reconstruction = []
    for number, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if line.startswith("func "):
            found = function_start.match(line)
            function = found.group(1) if found else None
            views = {}
        matched = capture.match(line.rstrip("\n"))
        if matched:
            assert function is not None, (number, line)
            indent, name, receiver = matched.groups()
            assert name not in views, (function, name, number)
            views[name] = {"indent": indent, "receiver": receiver, "line": number}
            regions.append({"function": function, "view": name, "capture_line": number, "receiver": receiver})
        found = list(access.finditer(line))
        if found:
            assert len(found) == 1 and function is not None, (number, line)
            name = found[0].group(2)
            assert name in views, (number, name, line)
            region = views[name]
            # All recognized production calls are one-line statements with
            # exactly one memory access and pure remaining operands. Existing
            # first-access capture stays in place; add reloads before later
            # memory statements, retaining copies and every original access.
            reload = region["indent"] + name + " = " + region["receiver"] + ".memory\n"
            if not output or output[-1] != reload:
                output.append(reload)
                extra.append({"function": function, "view": name, "before_line": number})
            accesses.append({"function": function, "view": name, "line": number, "helper": found[0].group(1)})
            counts.setdefault((function, name), []).append(found[0].group(1))
        output.append(line)
        original_reconstruction.append(line)
    assert regions and len(accesses) >= 2 * len(regions), "no complete production publication regions"
    for region in regions:
        helpers = counts[(region["function"], region["view"])]
        assert helpers.count("store32") == 2 and helpers.count("load32") <= 1, region
    assert "".join(original_reconstruction).encode() == raw
    transformed = "".join(output).encode()
    assert transformed != raw and extra, "reload control changed no memory statements"
    # No source, artifact, or spike writes outside the explicitly supplied
    # ignored output paths. Function/line names here record provenance only.
    with args.output.open("xb") as output_file:
        output_file.write(transformed)
    overlay = {"Replace": {str(args.production_path.resolve()): str(args.output.resolve())}}
    with args.overlay.open("x") as output_file:
        json.dump(overlay, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write("\n")
    provenance = {"input": str(args.source.resolve()), "input_sha256": actual,
                  "output": str(args.output.resolve()), "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(transformed).hexdigest(),
                  "regions": regions, "accesses": accesses, "added_reloads": extra,
                  "original_lines_retained": True,
                  "limitations": "Fixed final-output diagnostic only. Same publication inventory/local declarations, reload before each eligible memory statement. Must pass whole-package original-Wasm/count oracles before freeze. Different placement, liveness, and generated bounds code limit causal attribution. This is not production recognition or a generic safety proof."}
    with args.provenance.open("x") as output_file:
        json.dump(provenance, output_file, indent=2)
        output_file.write("\n")
    print(len(regions), "production regions;", len(accesses), "accesses;", len(extra), "added diagnostic reloads. No build or timing run.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== .cache/memory-views/qualification-notes.txt SHA256 209dee9a922b3c53fa715877248dff1dfd9517d63d49d6a9920562a6eff0c11e =====
Prepared 2026-10-11 by host reviewer. Ignored helpers only; no builds or timings run.

Plan: 17 frozen broad leaves, 59 role invocations/pass, 826 complete raw rows
across seven alternating 500ms passes and seven reversed one-second passes.
DD roles before/after/reload/reference; Guest before/after/reload; four streaming
leaves each with distinct before/after binaries. No function-name or line-number
filters are production selection inputs. This inventory deliberately repeats
phase0's broad inputs and holdouts; independent reference original batch/trace
ratios are not matched workloads and cannot support production gains.

Preparation requires parent authorization; none of the following has been run:
1. Finish reviews, meaningful executable proofs, all gates, and repeat generation.
2. Freeze production after.test and stream-after.test with Go1.26.8, CGO0,
   GOAMD64v1, -pgo=off, exact current matching harness. Freeze stream-before.test
   from the baseline revision using identical authored benchmark files.
3. Produce a SHA-pinned reload-per-memory-statement diagnostic overlay from the
   actual new hardener output, preserving its exact selected region inventory
   and local declarations. Do not reuse the broader phase0 probe/region list.
   Compare control to before and after; differing placement/liveness/bounds code
   remain attribution limits. Record frame/spill/code-size/reload evidence.
4. After parent approval, run reference-build.py --execute-build. It uses a new
   reference-rust target, the independent spike's original Rust/ABI2 source,
   Rust1.97 std,panic_abort, Binaryen133, wasm2go0.4.16, the independent hardener,
   adapted matched harness, whole-reference tests, and one-iteration benchmark
   oracles. These preparation oracles are not qualification timing samples.
5. Fill qualification-config.template.json build records and source identities,
   add exact baseline/candidate build logs, module/overlay/control inventories,
   pipeline fingerprints and fresh spike artifacts. Capture tool executable
   hashes and versions too; do not infer -pgo=off from go version -m alone.
6. Run freeze.py CONFIG --output SNAPSHOT.json only after all inputs exist. It
   checks benchmark files against 865be46 and validates every binary's Go1.26.8,
   CGO0, amd64v1 build info. Do not edit these helper files after freezing them.
7. Stop every build/test/lint/fuzz/profile/reviewer tool. Parent must authorize
   measurements separately. paired.py SNAPSHOT --output NEW-RUN-DIR
   --execute-isolated is the only timing entrypoint; it refuses existing runs.
8. After timings end, summarize.py NEW-RUN-DIR preserves all metrics/samples and
   emits benchstat p-values and medians. It makes no automatic acceptance claim.
   Archive frozen provenance, complete raw stdout/stderr, scripts, all negative
   and failed runs, oracles, gate logs, and machine-code evidence together.

Actual-procs limitation: original seven and raw Guest have no custom metric.
Their frozen source has no processor override; env GOMAXPROCS16, -test.cpu16 and
framework -16 row suffix are checked. This is not an invented in-window metric.
P1 corpus/matched/SQL holdouts and all streaming leaves require actual-procs.

Pipeline audit: internal/build.Project already routes translated output through
harden.Rewrite before publication; Lock.Go fingerprints the final translated
bytes. A hardener-only change needs no ABI/schema/manifest/lock-format change.
All three proof modules and locks must regenerate from authored sources. Existing
Rust/Wasm/facade/adapter/contract/differential/bulk hashes should remain identical
if no corresponding authored input changed; Go hashes change only where eligible
regions actually transform. Verify instead of assuming this expectation.

Native386: cross compilation does not execute translated code. Execute the new
WAT/generated-Go fixture and representative generated contract/wazero/native
checks on 386 with CGO0, including widened addresses above MaxUint32, negative
i32 bases, late trap after earlier successful stores, overlapping bytes, and
len<cap/header replacement after imports. The same helpers must enforce logical
length before uintptr truncation can reach unsafe memory. Match architecture
constants/bindings, and leave unsupported modules unchanged. Available arm64
native execution/performance must be reported separately; absent hardware is a
qualification limitation, not a pass inferred from cross compilation.

Required gates: make check (project-pinned2.13.1), race, rust, cross, smoke, fuzz,
integration; repeat all three proof builds plus go generate ./rt twice with byte
equality of every artifact/lock. Ensure make smoke's test selector actually runs
the new executable memory-view test. Smoke's CGO0 child is not automatically
race-instrumented by the parent; do not claim otherwise. Full DD/stream consumer
oracles should also run under measurement Go1.26.8 before freeze.

Retention: require repeated end-to-end batch gain; preserve broad/SQL/scalar and
streaming negatives and uncertainty. >=3% repeated guard loss rejects; smaller
repeated standalone scalar losses are not waived by that threshold. A raw Guest
delta, one control result, or absent significance does not establish scalar
benefit or equivalence. No scalar improvement or M1 acceptance claim.

def run(name,args,extra=None):
 with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log,flush=True)
  subprocess.run(args,env=env if extra is None else dict(env,**extra),stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print('PASS',name,flush=True)
for gate in ['check','race','rust','cross','smoke','fuzz','integration']:
 run('gate-'+gate,['make',gate,'GOLANGCI_LINT='+lint])

paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard','--',*roots],text=True).splitlines()
def fingerprints(): return {p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
expected=fingerprints();(out/'proof-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(expected,indent=2)+'\n')
for repeat in [1,2]:

 run('repeat'+str(repeat)+'-runtime',['/usr/bin/go','generate','./rt'])
 assert fingerprints()==expected
 print('PASS repeat',repeat,len(paths),'proof/runtime/harness files unchanged',flush=True)
(out/'proof-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(fingerprints(),indent=2)+'\n')
run('stream-compile',['/usr/lib64/go/1.26/bin/go','test','-c','-pgo=off','-o',str(out/'stream.test'),'./testdata/streaming/go/streaming'],{'GOAMD64':'v1'})

===== .cache/memory-views/summarize.py SHA256 9cdeb6a97e5f9a49113b76a76e72f3ab0451699806f6f0e243d3e313f9527808 =====
"""Summarize complete isolated rounds; benchstat is separate from timings."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import collections
import json
import statistics
import subprocess

from freeze import roles


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("run", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--benchstat", type=Path, default=Path("/home/dario/go/bin/benchstat"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    complete = json.loads((args.run / "complete.json").read_text())
    snapshot = json.loads((args.run / "frozen.json").read_text())
    plan = snapshot["plan"]
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (args.run / "records.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows) == complete["rows"]
    groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        raw = (args.run / row["raw"]).read_text()
        assert row["raw_row"] in raw and "EXIT 0" in raw
        groups[(row["round"], row["role"], row["name"])].append(row)
    summary = {}
    for round_info in plan["rounds"]:
        round_name = round_info["name"]
        table = {}
        family_files = collections.defaultdict(dict)
        for leaf in plan["leaves"]:
            name = "/".join(leaf["parts"]) + "-" + str(plan["framework_procs"])
            entry = {}
            for role in roles(plan, leaf):
                selected = groups[(round_name, role, name)]
                assert len(selected) == plan["samples"]
                assert {row["sample"] for row in selected} == set(range(1, plan["samples"] + 1))
                metric_keys = set(selected[0]["metrics"])
                assert all(set(row["metrics"]) == metric_keys for row in selected)
                values = {key: [row["metrics"][key] for row in selected] for key in sorted(metric_keys)}
                entry[role] = {"samples": values, "medians": {key: statistics.median(value) for key, value in values.items()}}
                family_files[leaf["family"]].setdefault(role, []).extend(selected)
            baseline = "stream-before" if leaf["family"] == "stream" else "before"
            for role, result in entry.items():
                result["delta_percent_ns"] = 100 * (result["medians"]["ns/op"] / entry[baseline]["medians"]["ns/op"] - 1)
            table[name] = entry
        summary[round_name] = table
        for family, role_rows in family_files.items():
            inputs = []
            for role in roles(plan, next(leaf for leaf in plan["leaves"] if leaf["family"] == family)):
                filename = args.run / f"{round_name}-{family}-{role}-normalized.txt"
                # Normalize ONLY the package grouping so the ABI2 reference
                # appears beside matching workloads; raw package labels stay
                # untouched in every individual source log.
                package = "dario.cat/cocoon/testdata/streaming/go/streaming" if family == "stream" else "dario.cat/cocoon/examples/datadog/go/dd"
                with filename.open("x") as output:
                    output.write("goos: linux\ngoarch: amd64\npkg: " + package + "\n")
                    for row in role_rows[role]:
                        output.write(row["raw_row"] + "\n")
                inputs.append(str(filename))
            for suffix, options in (("benchstat.txt", []), ("time-benchstat.txt", ["-filter", ".unit:sec/op"]),
                                    ("benchstat.csv", ["-format=csv"])):
                with (args.run / f"{round_name}-{family}-{suffix}").open("x") as output, (args.run / f"{round_name}-{family}-{suffix}.warnings").open("x") as warnings:
                    subprocess.run([str(args.benchstat), *options, *inputs], stdout=output, stderr=warnings, check=True)
    with (args.run / "summary.json").open("x") as output:
        json.dump(summary, output, indent=2)
        output.write("\n")
    print("Complete raw sample inventory verified. Exploratory p-values are in benchstat outputs; no acceptance or equivalence inferred.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
